environment.name: CLERK_AUTHORIZED_PARTIES
environment.purpose: Comma-separated list of origins allowed to present Clerk session cookies; protects against subdomain cookie leaking

environment.name: GOG_GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI
environment.purpose: Canonical registered hosted Google OAuth callback URI

environment.name: GOG_RUNNER_WIF_PROVIDER
environment.purpose: Dedicated Google workload identity provider resource name

environment.name: GOG_RUNNER_WIF_ISSUER
environment.purpose: Fixed trusted hosted Worker issuer origin

environment.name: GOG_RUNNER_WIF_KEY_ID
environment.purpose: Public identifier of the pinned workload signing key

environment.name: GOG_RUNNER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
environment.purpose: Existing Google service identity for private Cloud Run invocation

secrets.name: GOG_GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.purpose: Central Google OAuth token exchange and refresh in the Worker; the stateless Go runner receives only ephemeral access tokens

secrets.name: GOG_HOSTED_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.purpose: Root encryption material for delegated Google credentials

secrets.name: GOG_RUNNER_INVOCATION_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Shared authentication for the private runner endpoint

secrets.name: GOG_RUNNER_WIF_SIGNING_KEY
secrets.purpose: Dedicated Worker RSA PKCS8 signing material for pinned-key workload federation; no Google service-account private key
